mapper.sql: c.diagram_id, c.user_id, d.title, d.diagram_type, c.current_xml, c.summary, c.analysis_json, c.version, c.created_at, GREATEST(c.updated_at, d.updated_at) AS updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM diagram_canvas_state c INNER JOIN diagram d ON d.id = c.diagram_id AND d.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.diagram_id = #{diagramId} AND d.deleted = 0

SELECT d.id AS diagram_id, d.user_id, d.title, d.diagram_type, NULL AS current_xml, c.summary, c.analysis_json, d.current_version AS version, d.created_at, d.updated_at FROM diagram d LEFT JOIN diagram_canvas_state c ON c.diagram_id = d.id AND c.user_id = d.user_id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagram (id, user_id, diagram_type, current_version) VALUES (#{diagramId}, #{userId}, COALESCE(#{diagramType}, 'basic'), COALESCE(#{version}, 0) + 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE diagram_type = COALESCE(VALUES(diagram_type), diagram_type), current_version = current_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO diagram_canvas_state (diagram_id, user_id, current_xml, summary, analysis_json, version) VALUES (#{diagramId}, #{userId}, #{currentXml}, #{summary}, #{analysisJson}, COALESCE(#{version}, 0) + 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_xml = VALUES(current_xml), summary = VALUES(summary), analysis_json = VALUES(analysis_json), version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
